g.text: - new is special keyword to allocate
if we try to access arr[20] , where arr.length = 10.
so compiler tries to solve arr[20] like:
arr[20] = base address + index * size of int
and this address might be reserved for another purpose
will lead to wrong address access thats why java has to
handled those edge cases and we can see this frequently
array[index]= base address + index * size of element
this formula help to direct access of random memory, that's why array accessing is super fast.
you can think as 2d array to array of string
col(arr[1] = 1020 + size of data(let int) * index
col(arr[3] = 2000 + size of data(let int) * index
1. caching: cpu fetches information in byte in its register(memory), can direct access those
array's element via index which is very fast( no need to travel to ram)
Expensive Shift: यदि एरेको बीचमा केही कुरा घुसाउनु पर्यो (Insertion) भने अरु सबैलाई सार्नुपर्छ, जुन O(n) हुन्छ।
